test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

We do not __expet__ Reema to follow all the rules from the first day of work.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. expect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"expect"** means to regard something as likely to happen or anticipate something. (उम्मीद करना)

 
 
• **Example: **We expect the delivery to arrive by tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **"Expict"** is not a correct spelling of any English word. (गलत वर्तनी)
 
 
• **Example: **N/A
 
 
 
• **"Expact"** is also not a correct spelling of any English word. (गलत वर्तनी)
 
 
• **Example: **N/A
 
 
 
• **"Except" **means not including or other than. (के अलावा)
 
 
• **Example: **Everyone was invited to the party except John.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. expect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expict** (गलत वर्तनी): This is not a correct word in English.

 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 
 
• **Expact** (गलत वर्तनी): This is not a correct word in English.
 
 
• **Example: **N/A
 
 
 
• **Except** (के अलावा): Not including; other than.
 
 
• **Example:** Everyone except Sam was present at the meeting.
